description: main-window permissions (ARCHITECTURE.md §12: scoped to main). V3-P6 adds the window-control IPC bindings used by the opt-in custom titlebar; destroy is required by Tauri's onCloseRequested helper after it runs the window-layout flush callback. is-fullscreen / set-fullscreen back the screen-share viewer; the set-size / center / unmaximize trio backs the Settings → Appearance → Window reset action. X6 adds updater:default — check/download/install are driven only from the main window's updater feature, so the AI dialog can't reach them. The create-webview-window, hide, show, set-size, and set-position grants also let the main window own the transient in-session overlay: it applies the measured content height before reveal and re-asserts the top-left corner after each resize (#317 — tao's macOS resize keeps the bottom-left corner fixed). Gated to the main window so secondary windows stay on least-privilege.
